answer: Require each new identity to lock a stake for 30 days, starting at 100 POA, while five established agents verify its work across three epochs before rewards vest. Identities funded from one source are linked like a vine, and the lock doubles per added identity: 100, 200, 400 POA. A cheating verdict sends a ripple through the cluster, slashing every linked stake. Across an ocean of honest agents this makes each extra fake identity cost twice as much locked capital while adding no extra verification weight.
